privileged_info_for_vlm: The polynomial passing through (0, 46), (85, 26), and (114, 27.5) is approximately f(x) = 0.0034x^2 - 0.623x + 46. The volume calculated by π * integral(f(x)^2) from 0 to 114 is approximately 363,137 m³. Dividing this by 2500 m³ per pool gives a capacity of approximately 145.25 pools. The VLM should verify the text annotation 'Capacity: [number] pools' matches a value near 145.
